rules.plan: GRADED (plan §9, bible §10.4 A's rules): every union entry; exact, or substring either way when both >= 5 characters, or edit distance <= 1 when both >= 5; multi-word names also as contiguous word sequences; allowlist = GENERIC only
rules.name: advisory named reading: exact, or the term inside the word (both >= 5 chars)
rules.common: advisory named reading: phrase-only (Direction B: never split a Horizon name into generic words)
rules.short: advisory named reading: entries under 3 characters not matched alone
rules.line: advisory named reading: A's whole lines with spaces / slashes / notes, matched through their expanded phrases
